implementation.name: Astrocade (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 17 HDL source files (2 systemverilog, 2 verilog, 13 vhdl) alongside 12 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not MRA-setname-derived -- a console core ships no MRA files. The core reimplements the Bally Astrocade / Professional Arcade, giving machine_id astrocde. Every id was checked against extract/machine.json. license_id omitted: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Astrocade_MiSTer/blob/master/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 3 text, but neither only-this-version nor any-later-version is stated there or in the HDL headers read (Astrocade.sv), and GPL's version scope comes from the grant, not the licence text. GPL-3.0-only and GPL-3.0-or-later are both consistent with what the repository actually says. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 17 source files (2 systemverilog, 2 verilog, 13 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.

implementation_dependency.note: T80 Z80 core vendored at rtl/T80/T80.vhd
